instruction: R2 CORRECTNESS-lens review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020H.1 at commit 3817384 on feature/wp-scp-022-020h1-versioning-rfc-rollback (post fix-round-1). Prior R1 correctness found 4 MIN + 3 nit. Verify bash syntax + that the same delim is used both at the open and close of the heredoc. For each, verify the diff actually contains the closure. (9) NEW edits: ADOPT-001 §12.7.8 SECURITY.md cross-ref + §12.7.11 threshold-from-pinned wording. (10) Are there any new correctness issues introduced by fix-round-1? Specifically: (a) Python heredoc in canary-replay.yml — verify the `<<'PY' ... PY` quote handling + os.environ.get() fallbacks + .replace() string substitution; (b) version-manifest.json _schema_note and _comment fields are non-standard JSON Schema — ensure no parser will trip on them; (c) the freshness-warning step now has TWO paths: pinned threshold + main minor — verify the comparison logic still uses `int(main_minor) - int(pinned_minor) > threshold` correctly. (11) Cross-document consistency: D-036 in DECISIONS.md references VERSIONING.md + rule-proposals/README.md; verify both exist and the cited claims are accurate. (12) FIX-ROUND-1.md table: each row's claim matches the diff. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON. NEVER recommend descoping. Fixpoint criterion: zero new CRIT or MAJ findings.
